title: Dental Implants for Seniors: Safety, Costs, Success
seoTitle: Dental Implants for Seniors: Safety and Success
seoDescription: Age alone rarely rules out implants. Learn what does, how risks are managed, and what older adults can expect. Plan a senior-friendly consult in Valencia.
excerpt: Health, bone and hygiene predict implant success better than age. See the evidence, the risks that matter for older adults, and how implants compare with dentures.
keyTakeaways: Systemic health, bone volume and oral hygiene predict success more than chronological age.
Studies cited in the article report 90 to 98 percent five-year and 85 to 95 percent ten-year implant survival.
Oral osteoporosis medications usually do not prevent implants; high-dose IV bisphosphonates need specialist review.
Implants transfer chewing force to the jaw and help preserve bone, which removable dentures do not.
Reliable daily hygiene matters; if it is not possible, dentures or caregiver-supported care may be safer.
